_form_note: Verified against the actual push workflow ('Push_Api22') in the .ds export, not just the form's own field definitions -- confidence is high. One thing worth knowing: the push script hardcodes data_map.put("institutionCode",141) on every submit -- it does NOT read the Institution_Name picklist value at all. So App_Institution_Code/App_Institution_Name are mapped below purely so the Zoho record itself shows the right institution (for your own reporting/audit trail), not because the API push depends on them. If SIUD's institution code ever changes from 141, that's a change to the Deluge script, not to this mapping.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list. Not used by the actual API push (see _form_note) -- only populates the Zoho record for display.

HEDB carries this as a separate free-text column, but the Zoho form only has one institution field (Institution_Name, a picklist driven by App_Institution_Code). This raw column is redundant with the code lookup above and is intentionally not imported separately -- left here as a reference/sanity-check column only.
Raw HEDB code is converted to a combined 'Name - Code' display value using the 'Academic Period' reference list (matches the form's displayformat = [Name + " - " + Code]).

Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Degree or Program Level' reference list (form's picklist is filtered to Code == "BA" || Code == "MS" -- if your raw data ever has a degree code outside that pair, it won't resolve; flag those rows for the app owner to widen the picklist filter).

Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Area of Specialization' reference list. HEDB notes '99' should be used if the specialization isn't listed -- make sure code 99 exists in your Zoho Area_of_Specialization lookup form.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file. HEDB constraint: cannot exceed App_Applicants -- worth a report-time warning if you see it violated.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file. HEDB constraint: cannot exceed App_Acceptances -- worth a report-time warning if you see it violated.

Date-time values are trimmed to a plain date (time portion removed) and written as yyyy-mm-dd. Note: the push script actually overwrites this field itself with zoho.currenttime on a successful add, so this raw value mostly matters for update-type re-imports.
